top_signals.title: US Stock Futures Rise as Oil Drop Buoys Sentiment: Markets Wrap
top_signals.summary: US equity futures advanced, signaling some respite after a bruising selloff in the artificial intelligence trade, with falling oil prices helping stocks to start the month on a positive note.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.
